title: Ghost and Protocol
premise: Dominic Marchetti, a financial-crimes investigator who faked her death after a cartel massacre she barely survived, has built a quiet life laundering clean money for a compliance firm. When her own voiceprint—recorded before the incident—unlocks a dead man's server in Zurich, she learns the defector who can expose a global corruption network is being hunted using protocols Dominic herself designed. Extracting him means revealing she's alive to the very people who want her dead, including her former mentor, who orchestrated both the massacre and the defector's defection as bait. In the end, Dominic chooses exposure over invisibility, testifying under her real name and dismantling the network, but at the cost of the ghost identity—and the last person who loved it.
about_author: Sable Quintana is the pen name of a former regulatory analyst who spent a decade inside the machinery of international finance before trading spreadsheets for sentences. She writes from a coastal town she refuses to name, drawing on the gray zones where money, loyalty, and identity blur.

chapters.title: The Clean Room
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Introduces her meticulous, sleepless life as 'Dana Voss,' flagging suspicious transactions by day and checking exits by night. A routine audit turns up a payment routed through an account that shouldn't exist—hers, in her dead name. Emotional beat: dread beneath routine.

chapters.title: Voiceprint
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The account requires biometric verification; on impulse she speaks the passphrase into her laptop. A Zurich server unlocks, streaming files stamped with her old case numbers. Someone preserved her voice like evidence. Beat: vertigo—the past is not buried.

chapters.title: The Dead Man's Server
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, with flashback fragments of the massacre. Inside: surveillance dossiers on a defector named Elias Brandt, plus a countdown timer tied to a wire transfer. Whoever built this expected her to find it. Beat: hunted by design.

chapters.title: Old Ghosts, New Money
chapters.summary: POV shift to Marcus Hale, Dominic's former mentor, now a private-banking power broker. He reviews a report confirming 'Voss' accessed the server and orders no action yet. Readers learn he knows Dana is Dominic. Beat: cold menace; the trap is patient.

chapters.title: Brandt
chapters.summary: Elias Brandt's POV in Lisbon. A mid-level accountant who stole proof of the network's ledger, he's hiding in plain sight, waiting for a contact codenamed GHOST—the handler he believes is dead. Beat: desperate hope, mistaken faith.

chapters.title: Contact Protocol
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Decoding the server's instructions, she realizes she was meant to be GHOST all along—the extraction plan uses her own tradecraft. She must decide: stay invisible or go get Brandt. Beat: reluctant commitment.

chapters.title: What Clean Money Buys
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She liquidates cover assets, contacts one trusted ally—her firm's security chief, Renata—who recognizes her immediately and demands the truth. Partial confession scene. Beat: intimacy vs. secrecy.

chapters.title: Lisbon Rain
chapters.summary: Dominic arrives in Lisbon; alternating with Brandt's POV as he spots her tailing him and assumes she's an assassin. Tense near-miss through the Alfama district. Beat: paranoia on both sides.

chapters.title: Two Liars, One Table
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Dominic corners Brandt in a café; each tests the other with details only insiders would know. He reveals the ledger implicates Hale directly. Beat: wary alliance forged over mutual damage.

chapters.title: The Bait Question
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. He activates the second phase: leak Brandt's location to the network's enforcers while feeding Dominic just enough rope. Interleaved with Dominic realizing the extraction window is too convenient. Beat: dramatic irony tightening.

chapters.title: Renata's Choice
chapters.summary: Renata's POV. Ordered by corporate overlords to report on 'Voss,' she instead burns the request—but tips off Hale's people inadvertently via metadata. Beat: good intentions as betrayal.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Nighttime exfiltration of Brandt via fishing boat; enforcers close in. A firefight forces them off-plan; they escape but Brandt is wounded and the ledger drive is cracked in the scuffle. Beat: adrenaline curdling into loss.

chapters.title: Interrogation of a Ghost
chapters.summary: Brandt's POV, recovering in a safehouse. He interrogates Dominic about the incident; she finally tells the full story of the massacre and how Hale let it happen. Beat: catharsis, trust cemented.

chapters.title: The Ledger Opens
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The damaged drive yields partial data: accounts linking Hale to the cartel, and to the server itself—he built the trap expecting her survival instinct. Beat: horror of being known completely.

chapters.title: Homecoming
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. He flies to meet Dominic personally, offering immunity and reinstatement if she surrenders Brandt—a seductive return to power framed as rescue. Beat: temptation wearing a familiar face.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Confrontation with Hale in Geneva; he weaponizes their history and her guilt. She stalls, recording everything, but leaves shaken—and followed. Beat: the past almost wins.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Renata's POV. The network flags Renata; she goes dark, delivering the recording chain-of-custody to a journalist contact before disappearing. Beat: sacrifice, stakes made personal.

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The server's timer expires: the transfer triggers, framing Brandt for embezzlement and issuing a kill contract on both. With options collapsing, Dominic decides the only exit is total exposure. Beat: resolve crystallizing.

chapters.title: Everything Louder Than Silence
chapters.summary: Climax part one, Dominic's POV. She walks into a federal financial-crimes unit, reveals her true identity, and hands over testimony, the recording, and reconstructed ledger fragments. Beat: terror transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: The Long Night
chapters.summary: Climax part two, multi-POV. Hale moves to destroy evidence and eliminate Brandt; a raid on the safehouse becomes a standoff. Renata resurfaces with the journalist's corroboration; Hale is arrested mid-flight. Beat: chaos resolving into justice, narrowly.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Courtroom scenes; she testifies under her real name, facing Hale across the room. Flashbacks finally settle. Brandt watches from the gallery. Beat: grief and release intertwined.

chapters.title: After the Ghost
chapters.summary: Epilogue, Dominic's POV. Identity dissolved, she sleeps through the night for the first time since the incident. She and Brandt part ways gently; Renata sends a postcard. Final image: an empty server, its timer stopped. Beat: quiet, earned peace.
